notes:
v1.8.3 Update
- Fixed external integrations opening configured shops by Foundry Actor UUID or current-Scene unlinked Token UUID.
- Shop directory entries now include a canonical shop reference that can be passed back to openShopByRef().

v1.8.2 Update
- Added separate Positive and Hostile Relationship price adjustments, greetings, NPC art, and item unlocks. Positive ranks apply discounts, while Hostile ranks apply markups.
- Purchase progress continues to reduce hostility and move toward reconciliation.

v1.8.1 Update
- Fixed missing and nonfunctional Theme & Appearance fields across all built-in layouts and themes.
- Ctrl-clicking storefront preview text now opens the matching Shop Settings field.
- Title accents now apply only to text wrapped in **double asterisks**, including Astra, Frenzy, and Paper Moon.
- Fixed Terminal speech-bubble scaling and related Dustroad, Astra, and Frenzy display issues.

v1.8.0 Update
- Added shop-level complimentary gifts with spend thresholds and one-time or repeatable claims.
- Added a compact player gift panel with progress, remaining spend, and claim status.
- Gift claims are GM-authoritative, and granted copies have no resale value in Stylish Shop.
- Lifetime-spend progress now rolls back with failed purchases and preserves the configured currency denomination.
- External storefronts can read gift progress and request claims through the public API.

announcement.title: 🛍️ Stylish Shop v1.8.3
announcement.content:
Stylish Shop v1.8.3 fixes shop links used by external modules.

  • openShopByRef() now accepts Foundry Actor UUIDs and current-Scene unlinked Token UUIDs.
  • getShopDirectory() now includes the canonical shop reference for each entry.
